description: Reputation summary for the sending pool: funnel totals (sent / delivered / bounced / complained), the derived rates, the threshold each rate is judged against, and feedback-ingest health. Use this to answer "is our sending reputation healthy" and to check a domain before scaling volume on it. Pass source_id to scope to one source.

source_id.description: Restrict to a single sending source (36-char id). Omit for the whole pool.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_get_deliverability
